title: Before Los Angeles: Buddy Petit and what became of Wade Whaley
summary: Williams was with Buddy Petit before leaving for Los Angeles in 1919, and discusses the group that went out and Wade Whaley's whereabouts.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Who were you working with then? Before you went with him?
Before I went to Los Angeles, I think I was playing with, I think I was playing with, Buddy Petit, when I went to Los Angeles. I went to Los Angeles the year of 1919.

I remember Fass tells about going out there, that he helped organize the group here to go out. That's right. And I know he said he picked up some of the fellows were working out there at Walter Dacu's, maybe at the bungalow out near the lake. Must have been. You weren't in that band though, Walter and Mutt and Wade Whaley, you weren't working with them. No, that's who went with us, Wade Whaley.
You weren't working with them at that time?
No, no, no, not at that time. What's happened to Wade Whaley, anyhow? I don't know, I can't hear of him. I don't know what become of him.
We tried to find him out there with Fass that year, we couldn't, no luck at all. That's right. Or he didn't know, or he didn't know at all. That's right, nobody, everybody asked, he didn't know.
Oh, his brother, we'll have to ask him, Bill. His brother? Yeah. That's in the quarter. His brother?
I didn't even know he had a brother. Well, I never met him. No, I didn't even know he had a brother.
